counts.source: Seoul T-Data daily card-tag archives (data_id 20006), one per service date
counts.why_these_dates: The archive is 446 MB per date. The dates are every date from 2026-08-01 to 2026-11-19 (the last one published) with a large session (KSPO DOME, arena, Olympic Hall or outdoor festival) posted by the D-1 cutoff in the frozen session table. No other date is fetched.
counts.boardings: Sum of PSNG_NUM over rail rows (TRNS_MNS_CD in the code book's 2xx range) of the three card products (DC, DD, DX) whose boarding station code is the site's, whose STDR_DE is the date and whose boarding time falls on that civil date; the clock hour is the boarding time's.
counts.alightings: The same with the alighting station and alighting time.
counts.level_against_training_source: source_levels.json: on 37-47 dates from 2026-03-14 the operators' hourly files over Seoul's card-based daily table are 0.999-1.000 on line 9 and 1.006-1.008 on lines 5 and 8. The card counts are used as they come, with no adjustment.
counts.check_per_date: Each date's station-day totals are compared with the public daily table. A date whose total differs by more than 2% at any of the four station-lines is left out and listed.

primary.as_in_protocol: Monthly origins from 2026-08, D-1 public attendance estimate, against the weekday-median baseline of the preceding 365 days, on every site-hour 06-23 that the source provides.
primary.how: Origins 2026-08-01, 09-01, 10-01 and 11-01 with the frozen rolling code. Each origin is fitted on the operators' counts through July plus the card counts of the fetched dates before the origin; nothing else can be added because only large-session dates are fetched.
primary.scored_on: the fetched dates except 2026-11-07, whose station counts were looked at on 2026-11-23/25; that date is reported separately and inside an all-dates line
metrics: egress-window total WAPE and bias per site-day
egress-window hourly MAE with its paired date-bootstrap interval
coverage of the 80% bands in calibration.json
the same for the day-of update with calibration_day_of.json

locked.what: The published model (model.json, fitted through 2026-07-31) with nothing refreshed, for every hour of every date. This is what the packet builder would have said on each of these dates.
locked.baseline: weekday median of the 365 days before 2026-08-01
locked.day_of_update: day_of_update.json and usual_alightings.csv of the bundle, applied to the alightings of the eight hours before the last large session's start hour

secondary: the simpler references and ablations of development.json, on the same rows
each session's KOPIS ticket count supplied instead of the D-1 estimate
by month, by station-line and by kind of day (dome, hall only, festival)
five-minute station arrivals against the single-show curve (not part of the protocol)
decision_rule: Scored once and reported as it comes out. The specification is not changed after scoring.
